sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Dense 29.6B vision-language model with a ViT-G/14 perception encoder and 128K context, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic use. Emits channel-scoped reasoning and XML-style ATEM tool calls rather than JSON, so it needs the dedicated `muse_glimmer` tool-call and reasoning parsers.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's new open-weight 30B parameter dense vision model, designed for local agentic and coding workflows. It is the first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, and is released under the Apache 2.0 license. This guide covers running Muse Glimmer 30B with Unsloth Dynamic quants for maximum performance.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: specs, pricing, and how to serve it | RunInfra
sources.snippet: What the vendor says is new " Muse Glimmer is a 30-billion-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows. It's small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU, enabling use cases that range from local agents and function calling, to local coding, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
